rime-ice: Simplified Chinese setup that works out of the box: full and double Pinyin, a long-maintained curated dictionary, fully offline. The default choice for most users.
rime-frost: Refined from rime-ice: character and word frequencies recalculated from a high-quality corpus; a rising star with excellent whole-sentence accuracy (larger download, includes the full corpus).
oh-my-rime: Minimalist template for newcomers: ships with Emoji, component-based reverse lookup, Wubi reverse lookup, and more.
